subject: Retention carve-out and fee-offset proposal — Order Form / SOW
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: John Park <john.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention carve-out and fee-offset proposal — Order Form / SOW

John — thanks again for the discussion this morning. As promised I'm sending the draft SOW and an initial proposal for how we can handle the data-retention carveouts your security team requested without materially changing the commercial framework.

Summary: Nimbus asked for shorter retention and a PII carveout on certain datasets. To encode that in the order form we can add a tiered retention exhibit (30/90/365 days) and map each tier to a small fee-offset to the committed throughput price so the economic impact is explicit and predictable.

Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_v1.docx (draft), initial notes in-line below.

Proposed next steps:
- Please review the SOW exhibit (attached) and flag any operational requirements we missed.
- If the retention tiers look reasonable, can your procurement/ legal team mark up the attached SOW redline and send back?
- I'll loop in our pricing/legal owners internally and provide a short fee-model by end of day tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0133

Subject: Re: Retention carve-out and fee-offset proposal — Order Form / SOW

Aditya — thanks for the draft. Quick notes from procurement/security after our internal sync:

- We need an explicit PII dataset carveout (definitions + deletion windows).
- For certain regulated flows we must retain logs for 90 days, but clinical extracts should follow a 30-day retention.
- We asked legal to mark redlines on the SOW; attaching their annotated PDF.

Please confirm whether the fee-offset approach will be applied as a recurring monthly discount to the committed spend or as a one-time credit. Procurement prefers recurring offsets that affect the monthly invoice so our finance team can reconcile easily.

Sending along the redline: Nimbus_SOW_redlines.pdf

-John

To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Retention carve-out and fee-offset proposal — need legal + pricing input

Folks — forwarding Nimbus' annotated SOW and procurement ask. Key ask: they want the fee-offset applied as a recurring monthly adjustment to committed spend. They also want tighter deletion SLAs for PII.

Can legal review the attached redline and propose contract language that: 1) defines retention tiers and PII carveouts, 2) specifies deletion timelines and verification, and 3) ties a deterministic offset calculation into the order form so finance can reconcile monthly.

I've attached an internal fee model (fee_model_v2.xlsx) showing three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive) — the offsets in the spreadsheet are currently modeled as recurring monthly reductions applied to the committed token rate. If we accept recurring offsets we should update the Order Form fee schedule to include an explicit "Retention Fee Offset" line and a worked example.

Suggested owners: Laura take the lead on contract language; Karthik to approve commercial impact. Can you both review by EOD so we can get back to Nimbus tomorrow?

Thanks,
Aditya

---
Attachment: Nimbus_SOW_redlines.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: fee_model_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention carve-out and fee-offset proposal — need legal + pricing input

Aditya / Karthik — reviewed the Nimbus redlines and the fee model. High level: the approach is reasonable but we need to be explicit and defensive in contract language to avoid open-ended obligations. I've drafted a short exhibit and sample clause (attached) that we can drop into the Order Form. Highlights: 

- Definitions: "PII Data" and "Operational Logs" broken out; retention tiers enumerated (30/90/365) with clear mapping to dataset categories.
- Deletion and Verification: Redwood will delete or make inaccessible covered datasets within the stated window; Nimbus may request a one-time verification report per 12 months.
- Fee Offset Mechanic: propose a recurring monthly offset equal to 10% of the monthly committed throughput fee for customers electing the 30-day retention tier, 6% for 90-day, and 2% for 365-day. The offsets are additive only if multiple dataset categories are carved out (explicit cap: 15% per month). The exhibit includes a worked example.
- Audit / Special Requests: add language that extraordinary legal/audit requests (e.g., regulatory subpoenas) may incur separately billable compliance effort; we've included an hourly cap notice.

I attached redwood_retention_clause_draft.docx with the precise wording and the exhibit table. If you both are comfortable with the offsets above, I'll prepare the redline to send back to Nimbus and have Pricing insert final numbers in the Order Form. Karthik — please confirm that the proposed cap and percentages are acceptable commercially.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
---
Attachment: redwood_retention_clause_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: John Park <john.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Retention exhibit and order form update — proposed compromise

John — thanks for the redline and patience while we sorted this internally. Attached is an updated Order Form exhibit and the proposed retention clause (redwood_retention_clause_draft.docx) reflecting the compromise Laura outlined. Key points: 

- We accept the PII carveout and the tiered retention windows you requested.
- Fee offsets will be recurring monthly adjustments to the committed throughput fee as follows: 10% for 30-day, 6% for 90-day, 2% for 365-day, with a hard cap of 15% per invoice month.
- Redwood will provide an annual verification report on deletion of carved datasets; additional verification or regulatory support is billable per the capped hourly rate in the exhibit.

Next steps:
1) If Nimbus agrees, reply with a short confirmation and we will (a) produce an Order Form with the retention exhibit embedded and (b) generate a DocuSign envelope for signature.
2) If procurement wants the offsets applied differently (one-time credit vs recurring), flag in your reply — we can accommodate but will need to update the Order Form language.

I've attached the working Order Form for sign-off: OrderForm_Nimbus_20270604_signed-terms.pdf (this is the Order Form with the new exhibit; signature block left blank pending your signoff).

Would love a confirmation today if possible — we have implementation slots reserved next week pending signature.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
